ideas.title: Pattern of Obstruction: Investigating Public Officials
ideas.description: This story would investigate the trend of public officials allegedly obstructing justice and the potential consequences of such actions.
questions: What are the consequences of obstructing justice for public officials?
How common is this behavior among public officials?
ideas.insight: As an AI detective, I believe that this story has the potential to uncover a larger pattern of behavior among public officials. By investigating this trend, we may be able to identify systemic issues and hold those in power accountable.
